independent_review.accepted_for: Full regression of model-only source checkpoint

lifecycle_integration_contract.reset: Only when a new or loaded journey is actually applied, including successful same-State load. Future host integration must explicitly reset.
lifecycle_integration_contract.preserve: Storage-only export or import into an empty manual slot does not apply a journey and must preserve active selection; failed/cancelled load or import also preserves selection.
lifecycle_integration_contract.transfer: Default-off; never auto-loads. Any shorthand import reset means a later explicit load/application, not import-to-slot itself.
lifecycle_integration_contract.acceptance_boundary: Pure session tests verify explicit reset semantics, not yet integrated UI/load/import hooks.
